050878: /-!
050879: # P14: canonical maps between the actual finite-stage `L²` spaces
050880: 
050881: The intrinsic stages `I.XSet Y` are nested subsets of one fixed quotient.
050882: Consequently the clean varying-domain model is the `L²` space for the
050883: restricted quotient measure
050884: 
050885: `S.actualQuotientHyperbolicMeasure.restrict (I.XSet Y)`.
050886: 
050887: This file constructs that model and proves the complete functorial API:
050888: 
050889: * restriction from a larger stage is a norm-at-most-one contraction;
050890: * extension by zero from a smaller stage is a linear isometry;
050891: * restriction is a left inverse to extension by zero;
050892: * both maps compose exactly along `Y ≤ Z ≤ W`;
050893: * extension has the asserted support; and
050894: * restriction and extension by zero satisfy the exact adjoint inner-product
050895:   identity.
050896: 
050897: The last section connects the ambient restricted-measure model to the actual
050898: subtype `L²` carrier constructed in P3 by a measure-preserving pullback
050899: isometry.  No representative selector is used.
050900: -/
050901: 
050902: /-! ## 1. The geometric inclusions -/
050903:

050905: at height `Z`. -/
